headlines.title: Xcel Energy, SEMCO ENERGY Gas Company and Upper Peninsula Power Company announce sale of Xcel Energy’s Michigan operations
headlines.summary: MINNEAPOLIS, October 06, 2026--Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL), SEMCO ENERGY Gas Company (SEMCO) and Upper Peninsula Power Company (UPPCO) today announced the sale of Xcel Energy’s Michigan natural gas operations to SEMCO and electric operations to UPPCO.

headlines.title: Jeffco Public Schools Launches Six Electric School Buses with Xcel Energy and Highland Electric Fleets
headlines.summary: Jefferson County Public Schools, Xcel Energy, and Highland Electric Fleets will celebrate the launch of six new electric school buses and six bidirectional chargers today with a ribbon-cutting event at the district's transportation facility in Lakewood.

headlines.title: Can Rising Customer Demand Enhance Xcel Energy's Growth Prospects?
headlines.summary: XEL sees rising power demand fueling load growth, infrastructure investment and rate-base expansion, backed by a large data-center pipeline.

headlines.title: Xcel Energy (XEL) Dropped, So What Is Catching Investors' Attention?
headlines.summary: Xcel Energy (XEL) has recently drawn attention after outperforming the broader utility sector over the past year, partly linked to rising electricity demand and its ongoing clean-energy investment program. The recent retreat in Xcel Energy’s share price, with the stock down 8.44% over the past month and 6.42% over 90 days from a last close of US$72.49, contrasts with a 1-year total shareholder return of 3.65% and a 3-year total shareholder return of 37.04%.

headlines.title: Xcel Energy Inc's Dividend Analysis
headlines.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Xcel Energy Inc (NASDAQ:XEL) recently announced a total dividend of $0.59 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-15.  This includes a $0.59 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-10-20.

description: Xcel Energy Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as an electric and natural gas delivery company in the United States. It operates through Regulated Electric Utility and Regulated Natural Gas Utility segments. The company generates, purchases, transmits, distributes, and sells electricity through its energy portfolio, including wind, nuclear, hydroelectric, biomass, and solar power from both owned generation facilities and PPAs, as well as its fossil fuel energy portfolio, such as coal and natural gas; sale and resale of wholesale transmission service; and engages in wholesale commodity and trading operations. It also purchases, transports, stores, distributes, and sells natural gas; develops and leases natural gas pipelines and storage facilities; operates interstate natural gas pipeline; and invests in rental housing projects, energy technology companies, and community solar garden nonregulated assets. It serves electric and natural gas customers in portions of Colorado, Michigan, Minnesota, New Mexico, North Dakota, South Dakota, Texas, and Wisconsin. The company was formerly known as Northern States Power company. Xcel Energy Inc. was incorporated in 1909 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
